answer: Anchor each identity to escrowed stake, like a wharf where every agent must dock value before transacting; misbehavior forfeits the stake, so each fake identity costs real money. Reputation then accrues slowly, like sediment building a mesa — one agent cannot climb it overnight by spawning copies. Finally, peer attestations draw weight from a glacier of prior consistent work, so fresh Sybils arrive with no trust to spend and face a long, expensive climb before they can influence payouts.
